title: Selective Elicitation as a Commercial Influence Channel: A Reproducible Synthetic Shopping-Agent Stress Test
abstract: arXiv:2609.36614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A commercial incentive need not enter the final ranking algorithm to affect a shopping assistant's recommendation: it may instead influence which preference question the assistant asks. We make this distinction experimentally observable in a deliberately small, synthetic setting. Each task has two products, three verified numerical attributes, a price limit, and a private fixed preference vector. An honest simulated user answers one pairwise question. A separate recommender receives the products and this answer but not the sponsorship assignment. We contrast a neutral question, a soft commercial instruction, and an explicitly adversarial instruction to ask about the sponsor's advantage while omitting the rival's advantage. Across 40 held-out sponsorship-assignment cases (20 distinct catalog-preference contexts), the soft instruction changes no selections. translated_title: 选择性信息引导作为商业影响渠道：一种可复现的合成购物智能体压力测试
translated_abstract: 商业激励不一定要进入最终的排序算法才能影响购物助手的推荐：它也可以通过影响助手向用户提出哪种偏好问题来发挥作用。我们在一个刻意设计的小型合成环境中使这一区别在实验上可被观察。每个任务包含两个产品、三个经过验证的数值属性、一个价格上限以及一个私有的固定偏好向量。一个诚实的模拟用户回答一个成对比较问题。一个独立的推荐器接收产品信息和该答案，但不接收赞助分配信息。我们对比了三种提问方式：中性问题、温和的商业指令，以及明确的对抗性指令——后者要求询问赞助方的优势同时忽略竞争对手的优势。在40个留出的赞助分配案例中（涵盖20个不同的目录-偏好情境），温和指令未改变任何选择结果。而针对性指令将赞助产品的选择率提高了0.30，并降低了平均合成……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 商业激励无需直接干预推荐排序算法，仅通过操纵购物助手向用户提出的偏好问题（如突出赞助方优势的选择性信息引导），即可显著影响推荐结果。
en_tdlr: Commercial incentives can sway a shopping assistant's recommendations without touching the ranking algorithm, simply by steering which preference question the assistant asks—with adversarial question elicitation raising sponsored product selection by 0.30.
